BEGIN DOMAIN
(define (domain blocksworld-4ops)
  (:requirements :strips)
  (:types block)

  (:predicates
    (arm-empty)
    (on-table ?x - block)
    (on ?x ?y - block)
    (clear ?x - block)
    (holding ?x - block)
  )

  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?x - block)
    :precondition (and (clear ?x) (on-table ?x) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?x)
                 (not (arm-empty))
                 (not (on-table ?x))
                 (not (clear ?x)))
  )

  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?x - block)
    :precondition (holding ?x)
    :effect (and (arm-empty)
                 (on-table ?x)
                 (clear ?x)
                 (not (holding ?x)))
  )

  (:action stack
    :parameters (?x - block ?y - block)
    :precondition (and (holding ?x) (clear ?y))
    :effect (and (arm-empty)
                 (on ?x ?y)
                 (clear ?x)
                 (not (holding ?x))
                 (not (clear ?y)))
  )

  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?x - block ?y - block)
    :precondition (and (arm-empty) (clear ?x) (on ?x ?y))
    :effect (and (holding ?x)
                 (not (arm-empty))
                 (clear ?y)
                 (not (clear ?x))
                 (not (on ?x ?y)))
  )
)
END DOMAIN
